description: Add PATCH /v1/notes/:id to the existing notes API. Title and body are optional, at least one must be present. Keep every existing route and schema field working.
behaviours: PATCH /v1/notes/:id updates title and/or body and returns the updated note with 200
PATCH with an empty object or invalid fields returns a 422 problem
PATCH on a missing note returns a 404 problem
Existing GET, POST and DELETE behaviour is unchanged
